Join us full-time at our stunning office located in the heart of Krakow! Situated in a historic building just steps away from the vibrant city center, our workspace blends timeless charm with modern amenities, providing an inspiring setting for your personal and professional growth.

Responsibilities

• Support the creation of 2D and 3D assets for environments, UI, icons, characters, and VFX.
• Help maintain and develop the game’s visual style across all aspects of production.
• Assist in preparing visuals for marketing materials (e.g., screenshots, promo banners, app store assets).
• Work closely with senior artists and designers to implement assets in Unity.
• Take part in optimizing and preparing assets for mobile performance.
• Contribute ideas and visual solutions for new features and live content.
